uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

3457-5921-5970-8296.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate one of the Seeker of Skybreak tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Seeker of Skybreak token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2317-6664-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat.

2137-4642-4927.description:
Cast Awaken the Woods with X equal to 3 by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control to their owner's hand, copying Awaken the Woods.
Resolve the copy of Awaken the Woods, creating three 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
Activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
2137-4642-4927.notes: Once you have infinite green mana and infinite land tokens, you may activate Uyo any number of times, targeting any number of instant or sorcery spells.

3175-6797-8207.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

529-3499-7690-8181--165.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2730-6495-6553.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2730-6495-6553.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1496-1981-2415-2438.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1496-1981-2415-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1417-2738-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Bridge from Below, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Repeat.

475-4017-4186-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-4017-4186-7810.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

943-2203-2597-3230-4235.easyPrerequisites: Wild Growth attached to Guildless Commons.
943-2203-2597-3230-4235.description:
Activate Coral Atoll by tapping it, adding two mana.
Wild Growth and Vorinclex's first ability trigger, adding two additional mana.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, allowing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, with the copy targeting Coral Atoll.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Coral Atoll.
Repeat.

215-5295-5709.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Forests.
215-5295-5709.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Rofellos from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Rofellos by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1619-2511-4605-5542-6145.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2511-4605-5542-6145.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Passageway Seer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Passageway Seer enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Passageway Seer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Passageway Seer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Passageway Seer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Passageway Seer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Passageway Seer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Passageway Seer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2511-4605-5542-6145.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

3941-4331-4993-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
3941-4331-4993-7693.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-1478-6972.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Elder by sacrificing it.
When Sakura-Tribe Elder dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Sakura-Tribe Elder ability.
Repeat.

328-2511-3260-4078.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 10 or greater.
You have at least two opponents, or your devotion to black is at least ten.
328-2511-3260-4078.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
Activate Chainer by paying 9 life due to K'rrik, returning Gray Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain that much life.
Repeat.
328-2511-3260-4078.notes: The additional gained life can be used by Chainer to return all creature cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under your control.

2173-4771-5220-6772.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

81-3099-4762-6774.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Loading Zone and Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

2034-4484-4871-7422.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
2034-4484-4871-7422.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {C}{C}.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1558-2638-3147-4231-4365.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-3147-4231-4365.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Mondrak.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1169-1308-2457-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2173-4771-5220-7192.description:
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying its mana cost.
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Grave Venerations trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-2557-3899-6968.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

628-883-5670--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
628-883-5670--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter on it, and its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter on it. Ashes of the Abhorrent also triggers regardless.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat

2034-2279-4772-5220-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-2279-4772-5220-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Quintorius triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

955-1563-2457-4772.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1274-1545-2034-3490.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-1545-2034-3490.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

101-2061-3617.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Walk each turn.
101-2061-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Vampire Charmseeker.
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

120-1061.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
120-1061.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Planar Portal by paying {6} and tapping it, causing you to search your library for Timestream Navigator and putting it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

49-586-1799-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Priest of Gix, adding {1}.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Priest of Gix on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Priest of Gix into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

711-1029-2757.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Fallowsage, targeting the basic land.
Fallowsage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to untap Fallowsage.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping the basic land.
Repeat.

607-1558.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can deal 5 combat damage to players each turn.
607-1558.description:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, Ria Ivor triggers, targeting a creature you control.
Declare that creature as an attacker.
Instead of that creature dealing damage to an opponent, instead prevent that damage and create at least five 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Phyrexian Mite tokens.
Repeat each turn.

548-3212-4377-5261.description:
During the end step before your turn, activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Brainstorm without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Brainstorm, causing you to draw three cards and put Walk the Aeons and another card on top of your library, ensuring Walk the Aeons is the topmost card.
Move to your turn, drawing and revealing Walk the Aeons during your draw step.
God-Eternal Kefnet's first ability triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U}{U} to cast a copy of Walk the Aeons.
Resolve the copy of Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Brainstorm without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

1020-1117-2034-3003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junk Diver, adding {C}{C}.
Junk Diver dies, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
Myr Retriever dies, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying at most {1}.
Repeat.

4050-4504-4766.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Endless Cockroaches, adidng one mana of any color.
Endless Cockroaches dies, triggering itself and Deathrender.
Resolve the Endless Cockroaches trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Endless Cockroaches onto the battlefield from your hand, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Repeat.

1952-2059-2792.notablePrerequisites:
Livio does not have summoning sickness.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{W}{W}{W}.
1952-2059-2792.description:
Activate up to seven mana-producing lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Livio's first ability twice by paying {2}{W}{W}, exiling Great Whale and Village Bell-Ringer with aegis counters on them.
Activate Livio's second ability by paying {2}{W} and tapping it, returning Great Whale and Village Bell-Ringer from exile to the battlefield.
Village Bell-Ringer and Great Whale enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Resolve the Village Bell-Ringer trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

1170-1306-4761.description:
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Teferi.
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Teferi's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, returning Mana Crypt from the battlefield to your hand and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1355-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Sanctum Weaver does not have summoning sickness. You control at least four enchantments.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Sanctum Weaver
1355-5200.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Sanctum Weaver
Repeat.
1355-5200.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, you may equip Sword of the Paruns to any creature you control and untap them infinite times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.
